title: Professor Layton and The New World of Steam Game's Trailer Reveals December 10 Release
content: Level 5 unveiled during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Wednesday a new trailer for Professor Layton and The New World of Steam ( Layton Kyōju to Jōki no Shinsekai ), and it reveals that the game will launch on December 10 worldwide for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam.
author: ANN

title: Nintendo Announces Kirby and the World Beyond Game for Switch 2
content: Nintendo announced during its Nintendo Direct livestream on Wednesday Kirby and the World Beyond , a new 3D game in the Kirby series. The game will launch for Nintendo Switch 2 in spring 2027. The video teases a 3D world as well as a world beyond that one hidden behind an invisible wall.
author: ANN

title: Nintendo Announces Metroid Ravenous 2D Game for Switch 2
content: Nintendo announced during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Wednesday Metroid Ravenous , a new 2D game in the Metroid series, on January 28 for Nintendo Switch 2. The company unveiled a trailer: Metroid Dread launched for Nintendo Switch in October 2021.
author: ANN

title: Attack on Titan Creator Returns With New Look at Major Fan-Favorites
content: Attack on Titan is celebrating a major holiday to commemorate a big anniversary, and the creator behind it all has returned with some special new art highlighting some of its biggest fan favorite characters.
author: ComicBook

title: Sparks of Tomorrow Anime Reveals New Story Visual Ahead of Final Episodes
content: Sparks of Tomorrow anime has revealed its second story visual as the Kyoto Animation series heads toward its final stretch. Details for Episode 11, titled “The Inviting Circuit,” were also revealed ahead of its September 13 premiere. The anime is streaming exclusively on Netflix.
author: Anime Corner

title: Guyver's Yoshiki Takaya May No Longer Be Able to Create Manga After Cerebral Infarction, Partial Paralysis
content: In Toy Robot's new Blu-ray Disc release of the Guyver 2: Dark Hero live-action film based on Yoshiki Takaya 's Bio-Booster Armor Guyver manga on Tuesday, Takaya provided the following message to fans: "I suffered a cerebral infarction, and paralysis remains on the right side of my body.
author: ANN

title: Kagurabachi to Expand World Tour With More Early Anime Premieres
content: There is probably no anime adaptation more hyped than Kagurabachi in the past few years, as fans have been wishing to see this shonen manga come to life even before its first chapter hit shelves more than three years ago.
author: ComicBook

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Fifth Ending Featuring "Sakura addiction" by Takashi Kondo & Toshinobu Iida
content: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its fifth ending, featuring the song “Sakura addiction” by Takashi Kondo & Toshinobu Iida. The song was used in Episodes 52-62, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Tensei Goblin dakedo Shitsumon Aru?' Reveals Additional Staff, Theme Songs, Main Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Nazuna Miki 's Tensei Goblin dakedo Shitsumon Aru? ( So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin? ) manga revealed additional staff, theme songs, the main visual (pictured), and promotional video on Wednesday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Rudy Learns of a Tragic Future in Mushoku Tensei Season 3 Episode 12 Preview
content: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 revealed the Episode 12 preview images and synopsis ahead of its September 13 premiere. The episode previously released the “Turning Point 4” episode, introducing a future Rudeus and setting up a dark atmosphere for the rest of the season.
author: Anime Corner
